subject.title: [Bug]: OAuth-only xAI: x_search/code_execution never register for CLI-backend (claude-cli) sessions — loopback MCP bridge omits auth profile store

question: Which open candidate should be the canonical fix for this issue, and should the loopback path use the agent-local auth-store boundary proposed by the stronger candidate branch?
rationale: The bug itself is source-reproducible and narrow, but two open PRs already target the same auth-sensitive gateway/provider boundary and automation should not open a third duplicate repair lane.

options.title: Land the stronger existing candidate
options.body: Review and land the candidate that covers prompt-time and live loopback auth propagation with agent-local boundary tests, then close the sibling PRs as superseded.

options.title: Ask for a combined replacement
options.body: If neither open branch has the desired auth boundary, ask for one focused replacement PR that preserves the useful tests and proof from both candidates.

options.title: Pause for auth-boundary policy
options.body: Keep the issue and sibling PRs open until the intended main-vs-agent OAuth inheritance behavior is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Land the stronger existing candidate
recommendation.body: Review and land the candidate that covers prompt-time and live loopback auth propagation with agent-local boundary tests, then close the sibling PRs as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent gateway loopback resolver history and is the clearest routing candidate from the inspected source history.
